page.overview:
Who is Fabrizio Barbazza?

Fabrizio Barbazza (born April 2, 1963 in Monza) is a retired race driver. He drove for the and teams, and has also raced in the Indianapolis 500. He retired after suffering serious injuries in a sports car race in 1995. He now lives in Cuba, where he runs a fishing resort and a go-kart track.
